claims: One UI 8.5 for the Galaxy S25 is in its final beta phase.
The 9th and 10th betas of One UI 8.5 added AirDrop-like support to Quick Share.
The 9th and 10th betas of One UI 8.5 added new camera filters.
AI-Powered Bixby in One UI 8.5 beta features enhanced deep-device integration.
Bixby in One UI 8.5 beta can act as a device expert.
Bixby in One UI 8.5 beta can control settings like "Eye Comfort Shield" or "Extra Dim" based on conversational requests.
Advanced Photo Assist in One UI 8.5 beta allows users to edit photos using text prompts, including adding, removing, or modifying objects.
On-Device Call Screening in One UI 8.5 beta enables the phone to answer calls.
On-Device Call Screening in One UI 8.5 beta enables the phone to ask for the caller's purpose.
On-Device Call Screening in One UI 8.5 beta enables the phone to provide a transcript.
Enhanced Quick Share in One UI 8.5 beta supports AirDrop-like file transfers.
One UI 8.5 beta features 3 new camera filters: Classic Film, Blanc, Pop film.
Motion photo in One UI 8.5 beta now only triggers when movement is detected.
One UI 8.5 beta includes improved multitasking with better navigation bar blending.
One UI 8.5 beta includes increased security with "fail authentication locked" for theft protection.
The 9th and 10th beta updates of One UI 8.5 were scheduled for April 2026 for Galaxy S25 users in select markets including the US, UK, India, and Korea.
